name: @simo/plugin-field-barcode
description: Display any field value as a barcode (CODE128/CODE39/EAN/UPC/ITF-14/MSI/Codabar/Pharmacode) or a QR code, without changing how the data is stored. Barcodes are generated locally in the browser, no external API is called.
description.zh-CN: 将任意字段的值以条码（CODE128/CODE39/EAN/UPC/ITF-14/MSI/Codabar/Pharmacode）或二维码形式显示，不改变数据库中的存储方式。条码完全在浏览器本地生成，不调用任何外部接口。
